fix_decisions.claim_text: raise path gives agent no display line while user sees could-not-be-displayed
fix_decisions.evidence: AC12 in acs-337.md mandates that a raising display-line computation keeps today's tool result with no display line; the divergence is the specified behavior

parking_evidence.basis: the behavior is exactly what the issue acceptance criterion requires
parking_evidence.failing_input: an exception from is_introspection_query or _compute_table_payload inside run_sql_display_line

fix_decisions.claim_text: too-large-to-show display line has no matching prompt instruction
fix_decisions.evidence: the issue's prompt AC requires instructions only for the cut and row-limit statements; the too-large line is self-describing text in the tool result. Adding operative prompt prose needs a model-context RED/GREEN micro-test and is left for human review

fix_decisions.claim_text: cap_size 0 when TRUNCATED_ATTR is set without MAX_ROWS_ATTR suppresses cap notices
fix_decisions.evidence: safety/limits.py:32-33 is the sole writer of both attrs and sets them together; line 98 preserves max_rows on re-cap, so TRUNCATED without MAX_ROWS is unreachable

parking_evidence.basis: both attrs are always written together by the only producer
parking_evidence.failing_input: a DataFrame with truncated=True and no max_rows attr

fix_decisions.claim_text: cap hit with no MAX_ROWS_ATTR drops cap signal; untested
fix_decisions.evidence: same root cause as F-5: unreachable state, limits.py sets both attrs together

fix_decisions.evidence: the system prompt is model-context text with no executable boundary short of a live model; the test pins the rendered prompt the AC requires. Left for human review
